steps.title: The Director
steps.body: The Director films the scene: a cast plays roles, walks to marks and plays clips; cameras cut between shots; sounds, title cards and logic events fire on a timeline. We put a treasure chest a few steps from the start, with a trigger zone in front of it, for Rowan to open.

steps.title: A new scene
steps.body: A scene starts with a cast (“hero” is played by the player character, Rowan), one mark and one camera that follows the hero. Each row of the timeline is a role or a kind of item; + on a row adds an item at the playhead.
steps.task: Make an empty scene named “Treasure chest”, 8 s long.

how.text: Click “+ New” next to “Scenes” (left), or “New empty scene” if there is none yet. The scene opens: the stage on the left, the timeline below.

do.say: Click “+ New” (or “New empty scene”): an empty scene opens.

how.text: In the Director tools, click the box with the scene’s name, type Treasure chest and press Enter.

do.say: Type Treasure chest as the scene’s name.

how.text: With nothing selected, the panel on the right shows the scene: in “Length (s)” type 8 and press Enter.

steps.title: A mark at the chest
steps.body: Marks are spots actors walk to and cameras look at; each faces a direction. The scene’s mark goes in front of the chest’s lid, facing it, where Rowan will stand to open it.
steps.task: Put the scene’s mark in front of the chest, facing it.

how.text: On the stage (left), find the chest. Click “mark1” in the cast panel, then click the ground just in front of the chest’s lid: the mark moves there and turns to face the chest.

do.say: The mark goes on the ground in front of the chest’s lid.
The mark stands in front of the chest, facing it.

steps.title: Rowan walks up
steps.body: Actor items are instructions: walk to a mark, face, play a clip, hold an item. “Walk / run to a mark” finds a path on the ground and arrives facing the mark’s way.
steps.task: At 0.3 s, Rowan walks to the mark.

how.text: Click the Director’s timeline (the ruler above the rows) at 0.3 s; the time in the tools reads 0.3 s.

do.say: Click the timeline at 0.3 s: the playhead moves there.

how.text: On the row “hero”, click “+”. An item “Walk to mark1” appears at the playhead and is selected; the panel on the right shows it.

do.say: Click “+” on the row “hero”: Rowan walks to the mark.

steps.title: Rowan opens the chest
steps.body: Now the moment itself: Rowan plays the “Open chest” clip you animated, and at the instant the arms lift, the scene sends the logic event “open-chest”. Your graph hears it, opens the lid and lifts the item out.
steps.task: At 2 s Rowan plays “Open chest”; at 2.9 s the scene sends “open-chest”.

how.text: Click the Director’s timeline (the ruler above the rows) at 2.0 s; the time in the tools reads 2.0 s.

do.say: Click the timeline at 2.0 s: the playhead moves there.

how.text: Click “+” on the row “hero”. On the right, set “Does” to “Play a clip”, then “Clip” to “Open chest”.
Click the Director’s timeline (the ruler above the rows) at 2.9 s; the time in the tools reads 2.9 s.

do.say: Click the timeline at 2.9 s: the playhead moves there.

how.text: Click “+” on the row “Events”. On the right, in “Event name”, type open-chest and press Enter.

steps.title: The fanfare
steps.body: Sound items play a sound event at a moment. The built-in “treasure” sound is a rising shimmer and a bright fanfare, made for finding things. ▶ next to a sound lets you hear it first.

how.text: Click the Director’s timeline (the ruler above the rows) at 3.0 s; the time in the tools reads 3.0 s.

do.say: Click the timeline at 3.0 s: the playhead moves there.

how.text: Click “+” on the row “Sound”. On the right, set “Sound” to “treasure”.

steps.title: Hold it up
steps.body: At 4 s Rowan raises both arms (your “Hold it up” clip); at 4.6 s the sword is in Rowan’s hand (“Hold an item”), and the scene sends “take-sword” so your graph removes the floating one.
steps.task: Hold it up at 4 s; at 4.6 s hold a Sword and send “take-sword”.

how.text: Click the Director’s timeline (the ruler above the rows) at 4.0 s; the time in the tools reads 4.0 s.

do.say: Click the timeline at 4.0 s: the playhead moves there.

how.text: Click “+” on the row “hero”; set “Does” to “Play a clip” and “Clip” to “Hold it up”.
Click the Director’s timeline (the ruler above the rows) at 4.6 s; the time in the tools reads 4.6 s.

do.say: Click the timeline at 4.6 s: the playhead moves there.

how.text: Click “+” on the row “hero”; set “Does” to “Hold an item”, then in “Item” type Sword and press Enter.
Click “+” on the row “Events”; in “Event name” type take-sword and press Enter.

steps.title: A title card
steps.body: Post items change the picture: fades, letterbox bars, slow motion and title cards over the scene.
steps.task: At 4.8 s, show the title “You got the Sword!”.

how.text: Click the Director’s timeline (the ruler above the rows) at 4.8 s; the time in the tools reads 4.8 s.

do.say: Click the timeline at 4.8 s: the playhead moves there.

how.text: Click “+” on the row “Post”; set “Effect” to “Title card”, then in “Title” type You got the Sword! and press Enter.

do.say: Type You got the Sword! in “Title”.

steps.title: Three shots
steps.body: Camera items are shots: a wide one while Rowan walks, close on the chest as it opens, then on Rowan holding the sword up. Orbit the stage to frame a shot and press “🎥 Camera from view” at the playhead, or let us place these three.
steps.task: Give the scene three shots: Wide (0 s), Close on the chest (2 s), Hold it up (4 s).

how.text: For each shot: move the playhead to its time, orbit the stage to frame it, then click “🎥 Camera from view”. The row “Camera” shows the three shots; the camera preview shows what the player sees.

do.show: [aria-label="Director tools"] button[title="A camera at the playhead from the stage view"]
do.say: Shots are added at the playhead from the stage view.
Three shots: wide, close on the chest, on Rowan.

steps.title: Start it at the chest
steps.body: Anything can start a scene: a zone, an asset interaction, a screen button, logic. The zone in front of the chest plays it when Rowan walks in, once (“Play cinematic” with Once).
steps.task: Make the zone in front of the chest play “Treasure chest”.

how.text: In the Scene, click the zone in front of the chest. In the Inspector (right), under “When the hero walks in”, click “+ Action”, pick “Play cinematic”, choose “Treasure chest” and tick “Once”.

do.say: The zone’s “When the hero walks in” plays the scene, once.
The zone in front of the chest now plays “Treasure chest”.

steps.title: Watch it
steps.body: Play the scene in the game: Rowan walks to the chest, opens it, the lid swings up, the sword rises with the fanfare, and Rowan holds it up under the title. Stop (F5) comes back to the editor; nothing that happened while playing is kept.
steps.task: Open Cinematics and press “▶ Play in game”; stop when the scene ends.

how.text: In the Director tools, click “▶ Play in game”. The game starts with the scene.

do.click: [aria-label="Director tools"] button[title="Play the game with this scene"]

how.text: Watch the scene to the end, then press Stop (F5) to come back.

do.say: The scene plays: walk, open, fanfare, hold it up.
